## MLBB Boost FAQ: Pricing, Timing & Account Risks | MLBB Boost

Source: https://boostmlbb.ru/en/faq.html

FAQ

# Mobile Legends boost questions

Answers to the most common questions about our service

Didn't find an answer? Message us on Telegram[](https://t.me/Cla1ve)

### How long does the boost take?

Timing depends on the route, boost type, player availability and account requirements. The calculator estimate is preliminary. Confirm the start time and expected timing with support before paying.

### Who carries out the boost?

The player is assigned for your route and format. Before paying, ask about their game experience and confirm terms with support.

### Can I follow the process?

Yes, you can watch the process through the stream option in MLBB by logging in beforehand on your second account.

### Is email access required?

Under the service rules, account boosting does not require email access. Sharing game account access still carries risks. With party play you play yourself without sharing access with the assigned player.

### How are orders placed and paid for?

Orders are arranged through Telegram. First confirm the route, player, price and timing, then read the offer and payment terms. Confirm full or partial prepayment terms before transferring funds.

### Can the booster be replaced?

Contact support if you have concerns about your order. Player replacement and next steps are handled under the service terms.

### Can I get banned for boosting?

Account sharing and game services may conflict with the game’s rules. Absence of sanctions is not guaranteed. Read the disclaimer and security terms before ordering.

### Still have questions?

We're ready to answer any question you have on Telegram. Don't hesitate to reach out!

## Still have questions?

Message us on Telegram to discuss your question

## MLBB Mythic placement: 10 matches, stars and price | MLBB Boost

Source: https://boostmlbb.ru/en/guides/mythic-placement.html

[Home](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/) / [Services](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/services.html)

Placement

# Mythic placement in Mobile Legends

10 matches where a win gives two stars and a loss removes none. A boost costs 165 ₽ per win.

[Calculate the price](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html)[Ask a question](https://t.me/Cla1ve)

![A crystal gate inside a ring of ten glowing stones](/images/guides/placement.jpg)

**10**placement matches

**×2**stars per win

**up to 10**Mythic stars

**165 ₽**per win, account boost

## How placement works

1.  01

    ### Entering Mythic

    After Legend I the next win opens Mythic and placement.

2.  02

    ### 10 matches

    A win gives two stars; a loss uses a match but removes no stars.

3.  03

    ### Then one at a time

    After 10 matches stars again change by one per win or loss.


## Price per placement win

Only wins are paid. If some matches are already played, the calculator counts the rest.

![](/images/ranks/Mythic.webp)

### Mythic placement

Account165 ₽/win

Role185 ₽/win

Hero205 ₽/win

Party335 ₽/win

[Calculate order](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html?type=standard)

## What to enter in the calculator

[**Rank and stars now**For example, Mythic 4⭐ means two placement wins.](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html)[**Matches played**The calculator checks that stars and matches agree.](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html)[**Goal**Mythic 0⭐ is entry only, no placement. Higher goals include placement wins.](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html)

## If you are still in Legend

From Legend V it is 25 stars to Mythic. Prices for them and for stars after placement are on the [Mythic boost](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/boost/mythic.html) page, and the full rank ladder is in our [ranks guide](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/news/mlbb-ranks-in-order/).

## Price your placement

Enter the matches played and your goal — the calculator shows the price.

[Calculate the price](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html)

## Frequently asked questions

How many matches are in Mythic placement?

10 matches. A win gives two stars and a loss removes none.

How many stars can placement give?

Up to 10 Mythic stars — five wins.

How much is a placement boost?

It is priced per win: 165 ₽ for an account boost and 335 ₽ in a party. The calculator shows the total for the matches you have played.

MLBB Boost editorial team · Updated 22 November 2026

## MLBB party boost or account boost: which to choose | MLBB Boost

Source: https://boostmlbb.ru/en/guides/party-boost.html

[Home](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/) / [Services](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/services.html)

Party or account

# Party boost or account boost

In a party you play yourself with the booster. In an account boost the booster plays on your account.

[Calculate party](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html?type=party)[Message on Telegram](https://t.me/cla1ve_boost_bot?start=site)

![Two crystal player figures on one platform](/images/guides/party.jpg)

### Account boost

-   The booster plays on your account.
-   Needs a login to the game account, not your email.
-   Faster and cheaper: from 55 ₽ per star.

[Calculate](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html?type=standard)

### Party boost

-   You play yourself on one team with the booster.
-   Your account stays with you.
-   Costs more: from 95 ₽ per star, and you set the time.

[Calculate party](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html?type=party)

## How to choose

[**You want to play**Choose party: you play, the booster is with you.](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html?type=party)[**No time to play**Account boost: the booster plays the route for you.](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html?type=standard)[**You need one hero**Hero boost: the whole route on one hero.](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/boost/hero.html)

Before sharing an account read the [security recommendations](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/security.html) and the [refund terms](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/refund.html).

## Compare prices for your rank

Price the same route as an account boost and in a party.

[Calculate the price](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html?type=party)

## Frequently asked questions

How is a party boost different from an account boost?

In a party you play yourself on one team with the booster and keep your account. In an account boost the booster plays on your account.

Why does party cost more?

The booster plays at your time and carries the game with you, so a star costs more: from 95 ₽ versus 55 ₽ for an account boost.

Do I share account details in a party?

No. You log in yourself and invite the booster to your group.

MLBB Boost editorial team · Updated 22 November 2026

## Which format to choose

[**Account boost**The booster plays your account with any heroes. The cheapest option.](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html?type=standard)[**Role**Only your chosen role, so role statistics stay clean.](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html?type=role)[**Hero**The whole route on one hero, raising its rating too.](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/boost/hero.html)[**Party**You play yourself with the booster and keep your account.](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/guides/party-boost.html)

## How an order works

1.  01

    ### Check the price

    Enter your rank and stars now and your goal. The calculator shows the total.

2.  02

    ### Order in the bot

    The bot finds a booster and agrees the start time.

3.  03

    ### Follow progress

    You can check your rank in the bot after every game and leave a review at the end.


## Price your route

Your rank now, the goal and the format — the total appears at once.

[Calculate the price](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html?type=standard)

## Frequently asked questions

How much is a boost from Mythical Glory to Immortal?

That is 50 Glory stars: 6,250 ₽ for an account boost, 7,750 ₽ on a hero and 14,750 ₽ in a party at the base rate. The calculator shows the total with your discount.

How long does a Mythic boost take?

Across completed orders the median is 4.5 to 8 hours per order depending on the rank and number of stars. The start time is agreed in the bot.

Can I order stars inside Immortal?

Yes. The count has no cap after 100 stars, and extra Immortal stars are our most common order.

Do I need to share my account?

For account, role and hero boosts the booster logs in to your game account. Email access is not needed. In a party you play yourself.

What happens to my stars at season end?

At the reset Immortal and Glory drop to Legend V, Honor to Epic I and Mythic to Epic II. Rewards follow the highest rank you reached that season.

MLBB Boost editorial team · Updated 22 November 2026

## How it differs from other formats

[**Hero**The whole route on one hero. Account stars and hero rating both grow.](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html?type=hero)[**Role**The booster uses different heroes of one role.](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html?type=role)[**Account boost**Any heroes when only the rank matters. Cheaper.](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html?type=standard)[**Mythic boost**Star prices in Honor, Glory and Immortal.](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/boost/mythic.html)

## How an order works

1.  01

    ### Choose the hero and goal

    In the calculator pick the Hero format, your rank now and your goal.

2.  02

    ### Confirm in the bot

    Name the hero and agree the start time. The hero must be on the account.

3.  03

    ### Get your rank

    The booster plays only that hero, and progress shows in the bot.


A hero leaderboard place for a server or country is not guaranteed: hero rating depends on match results. Read the [security recommendations](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/security.html) before sharing an account.

## What your hero costs

Pick the Hero format and a goal — the total appears at once.

[Calculate the price](https://boostmlbb.ru/en/order.html?type=hero)

## Frequently asked questions

What is an MMR boost on a hero?

The booster raises your account rank playing only the hero you choose. That hero’s rating (MMR) grows with the stars.

How much does a hero boost cost?

From 65 ₽ per star in low ranks to 175 ₽ in Mythical Immortal. The calculator shows your route price.

Which heroes can be boosted?

Any hero on the account. Over the year customers ordered 182 different heroes, most often Angela, Selena and Lunox.

Is a hero leaderboard place guaranteed?

No. Hero rating depends on match results, so we do not promise a server or country leaderboard place.

How is a hero boost different from a role boost?

In a role boost the booster may use different heroes of one role. In a hero boost the whole route is one hero.

MLBB Boost editorial team · Updated 22 November 2026
